head.title: myCHEF VIP Club Membership | myCHEF Dubai
head.meta_description: The myCHEF VIP Club: AED 199 annual membership with a 10% discount on the myCHEF coordination fee on eligible bookings, one canape upgrade a year and priority consideration during busy periods. Full terms.

opening_paragraph: The myCHEF VIP Club is an annual membership of AED 199 for 12 months, built for guests who book private dining with us more than once a year. It carries a scoped discount on our coordination fee, one canapé upgrade a year and priority consideration during busy periods. This page sets out exactly what membership does — and, just as deliberately, what it does not.

new_paragraphs: The VIP Club is a paid membership programme from myCHEF Dubai. Membership runs for 12 months from the date of purchase, does not renew automatically, and is non-transferable — it belongs to the named member and cannot be lent, shared or resold.
Refunds are simple: Refundable within 14 days of purchase if no benefit has been used; non-refundable after the first benefit is used.

VIP members receive a 10% discount on the myCHEF coordination or service fee on eligible bookings only. The discount is capped at AED 500 per booking, can be used a maximum of 4 times per membership year, and is not stackable with any other offer or promotion.
The discount never applies to:
Third-party caterer or chef charges
Ingredients
Staffing
Equipment
Rentals
Venues
Entertainment
Transport
Government fees
Taxes
Gratuities
Externally supplied services
That scope matters, so we say it plainly: on most bookings the myCHEF coordination or service fee is one line of your itemised quote, and the discount applies to that line — not to the booking total.
Once per membership year, members can add a canapé course to a qualifying booking: one chef-selected canapé, subject to ingredient, dietary and partner availability.

The qualifying booking must have a minimum booking value of AED 2,500 and no more than 6 guests. The upgrade is chef-selected rather than chosen from a menu, and there is no cash alternative if it is not used within the membership year.
VIP members receive priority consideration for quotations and available booking slots during busy periods.

Priority consideration means your enquiry is looked at ahead of the queue when the calendar is contested — typically weekends between November and March. It does not reserve dates, does not promise a particular chef and does not secure peak-season slots; availability always depends on partner acceptance and cleared payment, for members and non-members alike.

Message us on WhatsApp or email info@mychef.id and ask for VIP Club membership. We confirm the start date in writing, and your 12 months run from that confirmation. We are available 9am to 9pm every day, and we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours — so the arithmetic on whether membership pays for itself takes one short conversation.
An honest membership page lists the misses as clearly as the benefits:
No reserved dates or held slots — bookings confirm in the normal way, on written confirmation and cleared payment
No promise of a specific chef or partner
No change to how quickly we get to you outside the priority queue — we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, member or not
No discount on partner charges, ingredients, staffing or any other excluded line
No cash value — the fee is not credited against bookings, and unused benefits do not roll over, transfer or convert to cash
